notes: The owner's problem, verbatim: *"The Graham and Dodd model criteria these days almost always results in no securities being selected, and often because of the diversity of businesses and accounting practices in various industries when it does find things they are distressed businesses. We need to come up with a modern version of it that recognizes the complexity of accounting that exists today, and the reality of how the markets currently value securities, that keeps to the spirit of Graham and Dodd."* The diagnosis (MODERN-DEFENSIVE-SPEC.md §1). The instruments broke, not the principles. Book
